check.claim: The mpeg_card.bin image Beetle Saturn loads decides whether Lunar - Silver Star Story MPEG (T-27904G) detects the Video CD Card and plays its movies.
check.method: Saturn BIOS v1.01 (Japan), Video CD Card option enabled, region auto-detected from the disc (Japan), host clock frozen at 2000-01-01 00:00:00 by libfaketime 0.9.10 so runs are deterministic. 4800 frames; Start held 15 frames at frames 2400, 3000, 3600 and 4200. Repeated with each mpeg_card.bin image, with no file, with 512 KiB of zeros and with a 1-byte file; every other input is identical. Each variant runs twice in fresh processes.

result.statement: video_sha1 is identical across all 11 variants
